title: AchansFam MINI9 Electric Bike Pump Set (New)

comparisons.notes: MINI9 BIKE PUMP, AchansFam-branded unit matched visually to the Woot image (same body, orange buttons, case, tail light). Specs match: 3*1050mAh, 0-150 PSI, USB-C. Shopify variant available=true, $50.00 (regular $68).

writeup: Woot has the AchansFam MINI9 pocket electric bike pump new for $14.99, with only three left and a three-per-customer limit. It hits 150 PSI with auto stop, runs on three 1050mAh cells, charges over USB-C, and ships with a hard case plus a bonus tail light. Ailife Rider sells the same matched MINI9 unit for $50 on their store, so this is a clear cut versus what the brand store charges right now.
amazon_match_notes: Exact match confirmed: ASIN B0FJS2XNXR is the AchansFam MINI9 pump; product photo matches the Ailife Rider MINI9 listing (same AchansFam unit, 3x1050mAh cells, 150 PSI, case and tail light).
